items.title: RoALT's wait between accounts adapts to the client. It ends as soon as the previous client is past sign-in and joining (polled every 500 ms, at most 30 s), then adds a delay of 2-60 s with ±1 s jitter. Zenith's gap is max(stabilization, stagger), and validation keeps stabilization at 20 s or more. Mechanically, 16 accounts therefore cost at least 15 x 20 s = 300 s of pacing no matter how quickly each client joins.
